answer: Borrow category-3 safety logic: no single channel may release a reward. Each agent identity should need two independent proofs, say compute work and peer attestation from unrelated invite trees, and a mismatch between them trips a safe stop that freezes payout. Like a dual-channel guard checked at dawn before the line starts, a sybil farm can fake one channel cheaply but must climb a second ridge to fake both, pushing that cost toward the horizon of profitability.
